principles: Show the activity before promotional copy.
Retain scores, turns, private-role instructions and current objectives.
Keep detailed help where the mechanics need it.
Reduce simultaneous choices when controls become cramped.

verification.focusedTests: Buddy Box pagination/purchases and JSON module loading pass. Catalog validation and World Eater integration pass.

verification.existingFailureCheck: All three hosted-frame failures were reproduced using game source captured before this UI pass. Browser launch/render smoke checks pass for both games.
verification.limits: Browser checks cover launch, initial rendering and representative scenes; they are not exhaustive playthroughs.
